# Dip and Happy

> Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Shakshuka, labneh paninis, chicken and waffles and a crème brûlée cappuccino, served on Tyler Street in a bright little spot guests call a hidden gem.

- Phone: (813) 304-0606
- Address: 102 E Tyler St Ste 160, Tampa, FL 33602
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Dine in or take away; Online orders; Catering and parties
- Rating: 4.7 from 865 Google reviews
